newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish March construction costs up 2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish March construction costs up 2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finland's construction costs rose 0.4 percent in March from February, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.
The construction costs index rose two percent year-on-year in March, it said. In February, the year-on-year rise was 1.7 percent, up from 1.4 percent in January.
"Following the decline at the beginning of 1996, construction costs have returend to the 1995 level," SF said.
"Costs were boosted by the increase in prices of materials such as treated lumber, wooden window frames and water pipes," SF said.
